import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
venv = repo / ".venv"
python313 = Path("/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.13/bin/python3")
if venv.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(venv)
subprocess.run([str(python313), "-m", "venv", str(venv)], cwd=repo, check=True)
venv_python = str(venv / "bin" / "python")
subprocess.run([venv_python, "-m", "pip", "install", "--upgrade", "pip"], cwd=repo, check=True)
subprocess.run([venv_python, "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", "requirements-dev.txt"], cwd=repo, check=True)
print(subprocess.check_output([venv_python, "--version"], text=True).strip())
print("jobpipe environment ready")
